title: Require Civ7 Adapter Package Topology
forbids: runtime lowering, host tooling, generated authority, or unclassified proof inside the reusable Civ7 adapter package
why: The adapter package is a runtime-free contract and test double boundary. Concrete Civ7 map-script realization belongs to its mod application.
remediate: Keep only the admitted adapter contract, map metadata, current-map surface, mock implementation, and selected package proof.
message: The Civ7 adapter must preserve its closed reusable package topology.
